covers: JSE session to about 10:53 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, with Thursday's US close for reference
headline: JSE halves its losses: All Share 105,316 (-0.8%), Top 40 97,523 (-0.9%); miners still lag while the rand holds near R17.50/$
summary: The JSE All Share was at 105,316.36 and the Top 40 at 97,522.80 at about 11:00 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, 0.8% and 0.9% below Thursday's closes of 106,216.49 and 98,385.12, a recovery from losses of about 2% earlier this morning (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). Wall Street's last close was the S&P 500 at 7,175.83 and the Nasdaq at 23,879.20 on 19 Nov; US trading resumes at 16:30 SAST. Gold was at $3,582.00, about 1.6% above Thursday's $3,526.30 close but 7.8% lower on the week, and the rand was steady at R17.50 per dollar, 4.4% weaker than on 13 Nov.

items.title: All Share 105,316.36 (-0.8%), Top 40 97,522.80 (-0.9%) as losses narrow
items.summary: Both indices recovered about a percentage point from their early lows of 104,265.03 and 96,398.30 (around 09:49 SAST). The All Share is still 6.3% below its 13 Nov level of 112,387.90 and the Top 40 6.7% below 104,486.60 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026 ~11:00 SAST).

items.title: Miners trim losses: Anglo American -3.1%, Impala -2.7%, AngloGold -2.4%, Sibanye-Stillwater -2.2%, Harmony -2.1%
items.summary: Gold Fields was 1.3% lower at R574.33 and BHP 1.7% lower at R600.91, versus falls of 4–6% for the precious-metal miners earlier this morning (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:53 SAST).

items.title: Mr Price +1.9% and BAT +1.6%; banks pare losses
items.summary: Mr Price was at R181.40 and BAT at R1,007.83, while Standard Bank (-0.8%, R282.14), FirstRand (-0.4%, R88.03) and Absa (-1.2%, R206.40) are off their lows; Naspers -0.9% and Prosus -1.4% (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:53 SAST).

items.title: Last close: S&P 500 7,175.83, Nasdaq 23,879.20 (19 Nov)
items.summary: Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST. Thursday's close left the S&P 500 5.1% lower on the week and the Nasdaq 5.0% lower; the US 10-year yield closed at 5.05% (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 19 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand steady at R17.50/$, 4.4% weaker on the week
items.summary: USD/ZAR at 17.4993 late morning on 20 Nov 2026 vs 16.7584 on 13 Nov; the euro is at R19.19 and the pound at R22.93 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance).

items.title: Gold $3,582.00; platinum $1,310.50; Brent $88.43; copper $12,254/t
items.summary: Gold futures are 1.6% above Thursday's close of $3,526.30 but 7.8% below the 13 Nov level of $3,886.30; platinum is 12.0% lower on the week and Brent 7.7% lower (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026 ~11:00 SAST).

items.title: MTN +0.8% to R226.31, Telkom -0.1% to R66.95
items.summary: MTN has turned higher since early trade; both are holding up better than the Top 40 (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~10:53 SAST). No company news; ratings unchanged.

items.summary: No new US trading until 16:30 SAST; Thursday's moves were Nvidia -3.3%, Meta -3.3%, Intuit -1.0% and Deckers -5.6% (LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026 close). Ratings unchanged.
